exposure: Prior knowledge of cesarean delivery risks
outcome: Change in perception of cesarean delivery after adverse experience
Stated hypothetical choice if more information was available
Beliefs about general population's awareness of cesarean risks
cohort: Women who experienced Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) requiring puerperal hysterectomy between 2005 and 2023 and completed an online questionnaire.
finding: Decisions regarding cesarean delivery, especially those on maternal request, were often poorly founded due to misinformation and a pro-cesarean cultural context, leading to regret and exacerbating inequalities among PAS survivors.
mod_finding: Many participants, including those who requested cesarean delivery, lacked awareness of its risks and PAS, leading to regret and changed perceptions after their adverse experience, with CDMR recipients often having private health insurance and lower parity.
cross-section timing: Data was collected via an online questionnaire from 2023 onwards, querying perceptions regarding experiences that occurred between 2005 and 2023.
